title: Maintenance Quickflows catalog and safe-executor
creator: Marina Lopez
description:
Goal: Create a curated "Quickflows" catalog (idempotent, small task bundles) and a hardened 'safe-executor' runtime that allows support engineers to invoke common maintenance flows with RBAC, dry-run, and guaranteed undo semantics. The catalog should be discoverable in the Ops Console, versioned, and callable via CLI and the internal Admin API. The safe-executor must enforce preflight checks, automatic cooldowns, and scoped credential brokering so that flows cannot accidentally escalate privileges or run against production without a second approval.

Why: Current maintenance procedures are ad-hoc: engineers copy scripts from Slack, run from laptops, and we repeatedly see partial remediations and noisy incidents. Quickflows are meant to be small, reviewed, and telemetry-instrumented workflows that remove context-switching while preserving safety.

Non-goals: This ticket is not building the public-facing SDK or the full Console UI redesign — it's the core catalog schema, execution runtime, and the first set of 8 vetted quickflows (eg: refresh-edge-cache, rotate-api-keys-lite, restart-inference-pool-safe). Integration with SSO/OIDC and KMS will be follow-up work tracked separately.

Acceptance criteria:
- Catalog schema defined (JSON schema) and documented in Confluence with examples.
- safe-executor service implemented behind Admin API with: dry-run mode, RBAC gating, undo hooks, rate-limiting, and telemetry events for every step.
- 8 initial quickflows added, each with automated unit tests, idempotency proofs, and at least one recovery test.
- End-to-end demo recorded and a short runbook for on-call with playbook ID references.
- Basic Console listing implemented (read-only) to validate discoverability.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: private deployment packaging and dedicated capacity autoscale hooks (tracked as dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: 1) JSON schema and Confluence doc link exist; 2) safe-executor supports dry-run and undo and is behind RBAC; 3) 8 quickflows in catalog with tests; 4) E2E demo and discovery listing in Console; 5) Telemetry emitted for every critical step
